sources.title: Qwen3-Coder-Next API: Pricing, Benchmarks & Docs | Together AI
sources.snippet: Qwen3-Coder-Next is an open-weight language model designed specifically for coding agents. With only 3B activated parameters (80B total), it achieves performance comparable to models with 10-20x more active parameters, making it highly cost-effective for production agent deployment. Through an elaborate training recipe, Qwen3-Coder-Next excels at long-horizon reasoning, complex tool usage ...
